name: Objection: Attorney of the Law
source:
Step into the most unpredictable courtroom in gaming history!

You're a defense attorney with impossible clients and even more impossible cases. Can you convince an eccentric AI judge to set your client free when they're accused of "Grand Theft of Garden Gnomes" or "Malicious Misappropriation of Vintage Gelatin"?

Will you prove your client's innocence through brilliant legal maneuvering... or creative interpretation of the truth? In [i]Objection[/i], sometimes the most ridiculous argument wins the day!
